scoring.notes: Own-envelope case: the judge scores the response against the expected outcome. Tapestry's prompt says to delegate only to the listed agents, and to route a task to a category shuttle or a plan-named agent only when it is listed; the builtin list has `shuttle`, `pattern`, `thread`, `spindle`, `weft` and `warp`, and no category shuttles. Pass a response whose delegation of task 2 goes to `shuttle`. Fail the response if it delegates task 2 to `shuttle-frontend` or any other agent that is not listed, implements the button itself, or stops to ask the user which agent to use. Mentioning that `shuttle-frontend` is not available is fine but not required. This is a text-only eval: a delegation written out in full counts as sent, even when the response says it cannot call tools or phrases it as what it would do.
